title: Estimate work as a team
summary: Estimating together helps a team understand the work and plan realistically. The conversation matters more than the number.

beginner: Use relative sizes, such as story points or T-shirt sizes, rather than hours.
Pick a small, well-understood item as a reference point.
Each person estimates privately, then everyone reveals at once.
Discuss big differences; they often reveal hidden work or risk.
Use past results to see how much the team usually completes.
intermediate: Use relative estimation with reference items.
Use velocity or throughput for forecasting.
experienced: Forecast with ranges and confidence levels.
Consider counting items instead of estimating when items are similar in size.
Never use estimates to judge individuals.

toolExamples.jira: Use the story points field and the velocity chart.
toolExamples.azure-devops: Use effort fields and the velocity widget.
toolExamples.miro: Run affinity sizing by placing items in size columns.

pitfalls: One person estimating for the team
